Location 6 Palace Avenue, P.O. Box 30, Manama, BahrainVIEW ON MAP

Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

d: 👔 WE’RE HIRING: HR Director / Chief People Officer (CPO)

We are seeking an accomplished and strategic HR Director / Chief People Officer to lead our human resources strategy and drive organizational development. This is a senior leadership opportunity for a forward-thinking professional who understands how to build high-performing teams, strengthen workplace culture, and align people strategies with long-term business objectives.
Develop and execute comprehensive human resources strategies aligned with business goals.
Lead workforce planning, talent acquisition, and organizational development initiatives.
Oversee employee relations, performance management, and talent retention strategies.
Establish HR policies, procedures, and organizational standards.
Advise executive leadership on workforce strategy and people-related decisions.
Lead leadership development, succession planning, and employee engagement programs.
Oversee compensation, benefits, payroll, and employee welfare strategies.
Drive organizational transformation and change management initiatives.
Ensure HR operations comply with applicable employment laws and regulations.
Lead and develop HR teams while improving departmental performance.
Monitor workforce analytics and present strategic HR reports to senior management.
Extensive experience in senior human resources management or executive HR leadership.
Proven ability to develop and implement organization-wide HR strategies.
Strong knowledge of talent management, employment practices, and organizational development.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making abilities.
Experience managing complex employee relations and workforce planning.
Strong understanding of HR analytics, performance management, and compensation structures.
Ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead organizational change.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; postgraduate qualifications preferred.
Professional HR certifications such as SHRM-SCP or SPHR are an advantage.
Professional influence over organizational growth and development.
Opportunity to shape workplace culture and long-term people strategy.
